name: mirage
text: Bet slip: I found the cause. The slip measures its height when it opens, then grows as the warnings and the re-read price arrive, and it stayed at the first height (your screenshot shows the Bet button cut off). I fixed it so the slip re-expands to full height whenever its content grows. It's built and compiles, but not in an APK yet. It ships with the next release, and I'll tell you which one. Until then, dragging the slip up by its handle shows the Bet button. Live features: the live lane, the live bids and the live tail taker are all in the Live tab and Settings › Live bids, but they are off or paper by default. The cross-exchange paper journal (Novig vs Kalshi/SX) shipped in v1.0.8 and writes a journal only; it isn't on the Live board yet. Ordering the other leg on Kalshi is not built, because it would need you to change the standing Kalshi rule. Tell me if you want that.
